title: refactor(rest): move the /meta per-item write routes into meta-item-write-routes.ts (#23050 slice 13c)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Sub-slice **13c** of the `rest-server.ts` split: the fifth `/meta` group. Group G5 of `RestServer#registerMetadataEndpointsInner` is two statements, the per-item writes, of 405 lines (base `rest-server.ts:5284`–`:5688` at `9975c26ae`): `registerPerItemRoute({ method: 'PUT', … })` at `:5288` (the item save, `PUT {metaPath}/:type/:name`) and `registerPerItemRoute({ method: 'DELETE', … })` at `:5528` (the reset to the artifact default, `DELETE {metaPath}/:type/:name`). They move, re-indented one level, to a new module, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-write-routes.ts`, as `registerMetaItemWriteRoutes`. It is the first `registerPerItemRoute` pass-through: the module registers nothing on the route manager itself.

This follows the slicing plan (`os-dev-report` `6239704287`, sub-slice 13c), seat 1's ruling on it `6239783526` (quoted below), static-receiver ruling A `6205442867`, 13b's `handover_13c` list (report `6244193505`) and the claim `6244810707`. PR #24240 (13b, `646303eae`) is the shape copied.

Nothing else moves:
- the route table, the ordered server registrations, every server-visible handler and every INNER registration (method, path, metadata, arity, handler digest) are identical, base vs head, in 20 configurations;
- the published `dist/index.d.ts` / `index.d.cts` are byte-identical, and so are both bundles' 39-name export lists;
- one token of the moved body changed, the ruled receiver (below).

`rest-server.ts` goes from 7,746 to 7,363 lines. G4 and G6–G8, the umbrella `registerMetadataEndpoints` and its guarded swap, the inner head's bindings and `registerPerItemRoute` itself, every handler body, the class head, `meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `docs/adr/**` and `packages/spec/src/**` are untouched. #23050 stays open for 13d–13e.

## The ruling this follows (seat 1, `6239783526`, verbatim)

> - **Q1, A.** The four head bindings (`metadata`, `metaPath`, `isScoped`, `registerPerItemRoute`) reach each module as ONE `scope: MetaRouteScope` parameter, built once in the inner head. Each module destructures only what it uses, and body tokens are unchanged. The host stays class members only.
>   - `registerPerItemRoute` stays one closure that reads RestServer's guarded `routeManager` at call time. ⛔ No module-local copy: that would be a second copy of a helper (rule 2).
> - **Q2, A.** 13a's `meta-collection-routes.ts` hosts `MetaRouteScope` and takes `TransportScopedMetaRequest` from `ui-routes.ts`, re-pointing its readers in that PR. ⛔ Not `meta-item-read-gate.ts` while #24208 is open.
> - **Q3, A.** `rest-server-registrar-files.ts` exports a named subset, the `/meta` modules. The dogfood census's reachable count becomes "the umbrella's sites plus every site in that subset", and a control pins the subset against the number of module calls inside the inner method. This is declared at 13a with the anonymous-`401` ablation as the runtime proof.
>   - From 13c on, a module with no direct register site is controlled on `registerPerItemRoute(` instead.
>   - ⛔ No naming convention, and ⛔ never "let blindSpot rise".
> - **Q4, A.** `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY`, a `private static readonly` field set once at class evaluation, is handed over by value. 13b and 13d name it in their claims, together with each sub-slice's static-receiver tokens (13 in all, ruling A `6205442867`).
> - **Q5, A.** G4 (891 lines, one `if`) moves whole in 13b, with its switch. Slice 1 moved 1,181 lines. The fallback, if the review budget binds, is B: a move-only split called inside the remaining brace. ⛔ C (re-shaping the registrations) is not a move and not this card's.
> - **Q6.** A for the two body-only 13b helpers (`notImplementedRefusalAnswer`, `anonymousFormIntakeFingerprint`): they move with the body. B for `refuseNonAuthoringCaller` (13d): it stays and is exported, because its callee `mayReadAuthoringTrail` is a docs anchor (`system-context.mdx:108`). Two-home helpers (`sendMetaItemAbsent`, `stampAnonymousFormIntakeWarnings`) stay and gain `export`, as in slices 1 and 2.
>
> **Binding on every sub-slice (from the plan's measurements):**
> - **Hosts are built inside `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`**, at the position of the statements they replace, with `routeManager` passed by value. ⛔ Never in `registerRoutes`, the constructor, an instance cache or the umbrella above the swap: those capture the real manager, and the moved routes would mount outside the anonymous-deny gate (#3963) and the type-level admissions (#21087, #21124).
>   - Each sub-slice proves this with the guard ablation in the plan: an anonymous request at every moved route gets `401` on head, and the ablation does not.
> - **The proof gains an inner-registration leg.** Slice 12's handler digest is blind to `/meta`, because every route's server-visible handler is the same guard wrapper. So each sub-slice digests the inner handlers through a recording `routeManager` and a direct `registerMetadataEndpointsInner(basePath)` call per base, with the ruled receiver tokens mapped back. A one-character positive control must move exactly that route's inner digest.
>   - The full-boot legs stay: `getRoutes()`, ordered registrations, `.d.ts`/`.d.cts`, and the 39-name export list.
>   - The config matrix is slice 12's 13 configs plus the `/meta` switches the plan names.
> - **Readers move in the same PR**, loud and silent alike, as the plan lists per sub-slice. Cross-lane edits are declared on #6017 (spec: liveness and gate tables) and #6023 (devx: checklist) before the PR. The `system-context.mdx` rows change with the sub-slice that moves their code.

## The shape

**Moved, at its position.** In the inner method, right after 13b's `registerMetaItemReadRoutes.call(itemReadHost, scope);`, the head now builds the host literal `itemWriteHost` and calls `registerMetaItemWriteRoutes.call(itemWriteHost, scope)` with the ONE existing `scope` (no second one is built). Registration order is unchanged: after the per-item reads, above the history family.

**The host, `MetaItemWriteRouteHost`: 5 members in first-read order** (a symbol-resolved walk of G5 with the TypeScript 6.0.3 compiler API, 13b's method; H1 of the dispatch holds: `PUT` at `:5288`–`:5523`, `DELETE` at `:5528`–`:5688`, the history family's first statement at `:5696`, the one static receiver at `:5340`):

| member | reads | handed over as |
|---|---:|---|
| `resolveExecCtx` | 2 | closure `(...a) => this.resolveExecCtx(...a)`, spelled exactly as the execctx census's forwarder |
| `metaSaveVerdict` (private static) | 1 | closure `(...a) => RestServer.metaSaveVerdict(...a)`, typed `(typeof RestServer)['metaSaveVerdict']` |
| `walledCatalogRefusal` | 2 | closure |
| `resolveProtocol` | 2 | closure |
| `resolveMetaWriteActor` | 2 | closure |

**No `routeManager` member (the plan's 5, H1).** The body reads the route manager nowhere: both statements register through `registerPerItemRoute`, which reaches the module in `scope` as the inner head's ONE closure (Q1 A, ⛔ no module-local copy). That closure reads the server's `this.routeManager` at call time; every call runs during the inner call, inside the umbrella's swap, so both routes still mount behind the wrapping registrar and still answer to `metadata.endpoints.item`, which the same closure reads. The module header and the comment above the literal say why. The walk found no bare `this`, no `this[...]`, no `function` keyword and no assignment to a `this` member, and the body reads no instance FIELD at request time, so no member is a getter.

**Host placement (binding).** The literal is built inside `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, at G5's old position. It is not built in `registerRoutes`, the constructor, an instance cache or the umbrella above the swap. For a pass-through module the swap is read through `registerPerItemRoute`'s call-time `this.routeManager`, so the guard ablation below plants the wrong shape this module could take: a module-local registrar reading a manager captured above the swap.

**The scope (Q1 A).** The module opens with `const { metaPath, isScoped, registerPerItemRoute } = scope;`, the three bindings it reads. It does not read `metadata`: the per-item switch is read inside `registerPerItemRoute`, where it always was.

**The one changed token (ruling A, named in the claim).** At base `rest-server.ts:5340` the save door calls `RestServer.metaSaveVerdict(ctx)`. It is now `this.metaSaveVerdict(ctx)` through the host (module `:187`). The static reads nothing but its argument, so the receiver is the whole difference.

**Module-level names** (the same walk, base vs head):
- **Imported from `./rest-server.js`:** `META_ITEM_RESET_PARAMS` (stays: `rest-server-meta-member-selector.test.ts` imports it from there) and `metaItemPackageBinding` (on the package entry). Both are read only at request time, so the two modules importing each other cannot see one uninitialised.
- **Imports that left `rest-server.ts`** (read only by the moved code, so `noUnusedLocals` would refuse them; a pointer comment is left at each): the local `META_ITEM_SAVE_PARAMS` import (`./meta-item-read-gate.js`; the re-export that names it stays), `metaSaveRequestOptions` (`./meta-save-request.js`), and `SaveMetaItemRequest` and `DeleteMetaItemRequest` (`@objectstack/spec/api`). Exactly the plan's four. `META_ITEM_RESET_PARAMS` stays, as the plan says.
- **Unchanged provenance:** every other name (`rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable`, `metaWriteCapabilityVerdict`, `handleRouteError`, `META_ITEM_MEMBER_PARAM`, `metaMemberSelector`, `refuseUnknownQueryParams`, `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`) is imported from the module `rest-server.ts` imports it from, and is still read there too. `MetaRouteScope` and `TransportScopedMetaRequest` come from `./meta-collection-routes.js`.

## Proof

All runs went through `os-verify-lock`, with every exit captured before any pipe, unless noted. The base is `9975c26ae`, measured in a read-only comparison worktree. The head is `3750ddecc`; the merge head `39912f9e1` adds one merge of `origin/main` `cbfa5e433` (#24244), which touches `packages/runtime` only, outside `@objectstack/rest`'s dependency closure (`core`, `metadata`, `metadata-core`, `observability`, `platform-objects`, `service-package`, `spec`, `types`), so main vs merge head reads as base vs head; the final commit `892a86538` is a comment in a gate script.

**1. The moved text.** `git show 9975c26ae:packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts | sed -n 5284,5688p`, with one 4-space indent removed, was compared with `meta-item-write-routes.ts` `:131`–`:535`, the body after the destructuring line.
- The raw `diff` exits 1 on exactly one line: the receiver token (`RestServer.metaSaveVerdict(ctx)` → `this.metaSaveVerdict(ctx)`).
- With `this.metaSaveVerdict` mapped back to `RestServer.metaSaveVerdict`, `diff` exits 0 over all 405 lines. Both sides are sha256 `a8935ad228caf0c790c7c1314782c6eb4405ca639cd95d8f5b453982f8069bb6`.
- Every non-empty line of the range carried the 8-space indent, and no line has trailing whitespace.

**2. `.d.ts` and exports.** `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` are sha256 `02f1c167ccbea3298a15ea77ac634b50500346fc489efec21828eb5a7ab5928a` at base, at head and at the merge head.
- The head-only marker `registerMetaItemWriteRoutes` hits 2 in each of `index.js` / `index.cjs` at head and at the merge head, and 0 at base.
- Both bundles load with 39 exports and one sorted name list, sha256 `b3246be6a1718700…`, ESM == CJS, base and head.

**3. Full-boot legs (slice 12's method), 20 configurations:** slice 12's thirteen, then the `/meta` switches under scoped-optional: `metadata.endpoints.types`, `.items`, `.item` and `.maintenance` each false; all four false; `metadata.prefix: '/metadata'`; `api.enableMetadata: false`.
- **Source leg** (a `tsx` boot of `src/rest-server.ts`): `routes.json`, `calls.json` and `handlers.json` are byte-identical in all 20 configs: 60 of 60 files, concatenation sha256 `bd4f6685175a61ec…` on both trees.
- **Bundle leg** (the same dump against the built `dist/index.js`): 60 of 60 identical, concatenation `20103136b32ff534…`, under one declared normalization: esbuild's numeric alias suffix on an import name two bundled modules share. Measured by an identifier-set diff of the two bundles, the ESM head gains exactly `itemWriteHost`, `registerMetaItemWriteRoutes` and two renumbered aliases (`rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable5`, `metaWriteCapabilityVerdict2`), and loses none; those two names are the ones normalized. (The CJS bundle gains `itemWriteHost`, `registerMetaItemWriteRoutes`, `import_core38` and `import_metadata_core17`.)
- Both concatenation hashes equal 13b's own readings: the full boot is unchanged across both moves.

**4. The inner-registration leg (the plan's `proof_method`).** Each config builds a `RestServer` with a recording `routeManager` and calls `registerMetadataEndpointsInner(basePath)` directly for `/api/v1` and `/api/v1/environments/:environmentId`: 688 recorded registrations over the 20 configs, digested whitespace-free with the ruled receiver tokens mapped back (13b's three plus `metaSaveVerdict`), together with method, path, metadata and arity.
- **Source leg:** 688 of 688 identical, same order; the digest-list sha256 is `4f306a2a19ffdd181b36b43e4d8b49d0844dc396c50a3144e8221aeab48b4511` on both trees (13b's reading too). Unnormalized, exactly 36 digests differ: `PUT …/:type/:name` on both bases in the 18 configs that mount it, the receiver token. The `DELETE` digests are identical raw.
- **Bundle leg:** 688 of 688 identical under the two alias names; digest-list sha256 `535abfd10375066c385a596bf97dd8039252b8fe3f38ebb7fc78e073cf8f98c6` on both trees.
- **Positive controls** (one character each, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 → 0): the `PUT` door's 501 message gained a `!` (blob `395d5e6ec2c9` → `82dd302865c5`), then, separately, the `DELETE` door's (→ `7b4819a6f8d5`). Each moved the inner digests of exactly its own route, on both bases, in the 18 configs that mount it: 36 of 688 each, and nowhere else. All 20 configs' full-boot `routes` / `calls` / `handlers` stayed byte-identical (60 of 60): the blind spot the inner leg covers. Restored each time: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**5. H2: the handed-over closure is the inner method's own.** An anonymous request at each moved route on both bases (one-off `tsx` probe, scoped-optional), base and head identical:
- `endpoints.item` on: `PUT` and `DELETE` answer `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` with zero protocol calls (4 of 4), and all four server-visible handlers are the umbrella's wrapper.
- `endpoints.item: false`: both routes are gone on both bases (150 → 126 routes, 0 `PUT` / `DELETE` item mounts), on both trees.

**6. The guard ablation** (the plan's shape for 13c, 13d and 13e-published). Two literal anchors, nested: the umbrella stashes its `realRouteManager` (captured above the swap) and `itemWriteHost` carries it as a `routeManager` member (`rest-server.ts` blob `2816281785c6` → `1528afc7f2dd`, a 281-line anchor from the umbrella's `const realRouteManager = this.routeManager;` through `itemWriteHost`'s opening line), and the module replaces the scope's `registerPerItemRoute` with a module-local registrar that honours the same switch but registers on that host member (`meta-item-write-routes.ts` blob `395d5e6ec2c9` → `6fdf0913c66a`).
- **Ablation:** an anonymous `PUT` and `DELETE` on both bases answer `403 FORBIDDEN` from the door's own capability gate, not `401`, and none of the four handlers is the wrapper. Under `endpoints.item: false` the routes are still gone, so the switch alone cannot tell the two shapes apart; the gate can.
- **Standing pins under the ablation:** `Test Files 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`, `Tests 9 failed | 121 passed (130)`: `meta-type-write-capability.test.ts` is red 9 times (#21124: the datasource and datasources write shapes for member, other-grant and author, the existing-vs-absent byte identity, and the admin-door parity for the author bearer). `rest-meta-auth.test.ts`, `meta-type-read-capability.test.ts`, `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` and `meta-route-registration-order.test.ts` stay green.
- Restored, both files: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No permanent test was added.

**7. The late-binding ablation** (one-off script). The 4 instance methods are planted on the server and the static on the class before `registerRoutes()`, as recorders that delegate to the originals. Six request shapes are driven over the two moved routes (a plain save, `?mode=draft`, `?force=true` with `If-Match`, a plain reset, `?state=draft`, `?dropStorage=true` with `If-Match`), each answering 200 after the expected protocol call. Then everything is planted again and the shapes are driven again.
- **Head** (byte-identical `MEASURE` lines to base): all 5 closure members are reached before and after the re-plant, with `early calls after re-plant: 0`.
- **Ablation:** `walledCatalogRefusal: this.walledCatalogRefusal.bind(this)` (blob `2816281785c6` → `fde53002af3c`) gives `early calls after re-plant: 6 ["early:walledCatalogRefusal"]` and 4 late members, exit 1. Restored: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

`rest-server-registrar-files.ts` gains `meta-item-write-routes.ts` in `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES` (length 15 → 16) and in the named `/meta` subset `REST_SERVER_META_ROUTE_FILES` (2 → 3). The dogfood control counts `.call(` inside the inner method, now 3, so the subset and the call moved together.

| reader | sum over the list | change |
|---|---|---|
| `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` | 62 sites = 10 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 0 + 6 + 3 + 1 + 2; mentions 137 → 141 | The two sites are locally caught on their invocation lines, as before, so the split stays 16 / 46 (12 on the invocation line). `rest-server.ts` stays at 55 mentions (two sites out, one forwarder's two in); the module carries 4. Sixteen forwarders: (16 − 1) + 3 − 2 |
| `meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts` | 8 = 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 2 + 0 ×7 + 3 + 2 + 1 | The reset's `?state=draft` (a `write` row) moved; keys name routes, so no ledger row changed |
| `rest-server-query-number-census.test.ts` | 9 = 8 + 1 + 0 ×14 | — |
| `rest-server-canonical-query-ast.test.ts` (`repo`) | 4 = 0 + 3 + 0 ×10 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 | Floor `meta-item-write-routes.ts: 0` (the save mapping's one `query` key sits mid-line) |
| `rest-server-docblock-position.test.ts` | floors sum 59 → 62 | The module carries 3: the header, the host interface and the function. `rest-server.ts` keeps its 161 blocks |
| `ui-view-route-identity` / `-tenancy` measurement tests | `this.enforceAuth(` 60, `this.resolveExecCtx(` 77 → 78 | +1 for the forwarder. The ownership guard is still 1 call site and 1 forwarder |
| dogfood `authz-conformance.test.ts` | 0 tripwire hits over sixteen files | Length 15 → 16 |
| dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` | 70 / 19 / 51 unchanged | Reachable holds by 13a's Q3 rule, with no rule change. Two controls re-keyed, as ruled (Q3: "From 13c on, a module with no direct register site is controlled on `registerPerItemRoute(` instead"): the module's own control is `meta-item-write-routes.ts: registerPerItemRoute(` 2 (its `this.routeManager.register(` count is 0, which this census reads as instrument failure); the derivation now emits one control per spelling a module spells, so a module that stops spelling its recorded one makes that control vanish, loudly. The whole-population `registerPerItemRoute(` control is re-anchored over the population rule's own haystack (this file plus every module on the list), where it stays 8 = 6 + 2; over `rest-server.ts` alone it would read 6. `/meta subset ↔ .call(` 3; `this.routeManager.register(` 63, `private register*Endpoints(` 16, `const registerPerItemRoute =` 1 and `enforceAuth` 112 unchanged |

Readers outside the list:
- **`scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`** (`MODULES` only; declared on #6017, `6244817361`). `meta-item-write-routes.ts` is declared `dialectOnly` with ratchet #9559 at `stringError 0` / `siblingCode 0`: both doors' 403, 400 and 501 bodies are the nested `{ error: { code, message } }`. `rest-server.ts` keeps `7` / `3`. Output: 26 → 27 modules audited, 16 → 17 ratcheted; `--self-test` exit 0.
- **`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 50** (declared on #20163, `6244820755`; H4 holds). The reset's `isSystem` read (`metaWriteCapabilityVerdict({ isSystem: ctx?.isSystem === true, … })`) moved with it, so at the move commit `check-system-context-census` exited 1: `[file-without-a-row] packages/rest/src/meta-item-write-routes.ts holds 1 elevation read site(s) in 1 symbol(s) (registerMetaItemWriteRoutes)`. Row 50 gains `packages/rest/src/meta-item-write-routes.ts#registerMetaItemWriteRoutes` beside the inner anchor, which keeps resolving (publish and rollback still read there). Made green by the anchor, ⛔ not by a `NON_READ_ANCHORS` row: `142 elevation read sites … across 65 files, living in 123 symbol(s); the page cites 136 symbol(s) against 136 required, over 159 anchors` (base: 64 files, 122 symbols, 135 / 135, 158 anchors).
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__meta-item-write-routes.ts.json`** (NEW; declared as possible on #6017). `check-adr-anchors` checks `ADR-NNNN Dk` letters only in anchored files. The move took G5's eight letter citations (ADR-0066 D1 ×2, ADR-0131 D3 ×2, ADR-0131 D6 ×4) out of the anchored `rest-server.ts`, and the gate read 1783 → 1775 while green: a reader that narrowed silently. This anchors ADR-0066, ADR-0131 and ADR-0106; its invariant adds no letter citation; the reading is back to 1783 (`73 anchored file(s)`).
- **Examined, unaffected:**
  - `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` derives `GET` handlers only (the item, tree, layers and list reads); G5 holds none, and the test was green at the move commit (`Tests 739 passed (739)`).
  - `packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json` (the plan: "No liveness edit"): the `endpoints.item` row's second citation, `rest-server.ts#registerMetadataEndpointsInner` (`registerPerItemRoute` gates the per-item `PUT` / `DELETE` and the history family), stays true, because the switch is read in that closure, which stays in the inner head. `check:liveness` was green at the move commit and at head.
  - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`' inner anchor ("metaPath and registerPerItemRoute") stays true; `check:platform-checklist` was green at the move commit. No other checklist or docs anchor names a G5 symbol.

**Red before the re-points**, each measured with the readers at their base text:
- **At the move commit `344cb18d8`:**
  - Six list readers read `Test Files 2 failed | 4 passed (6)`, `Tests 5 failed | 121 passed (126)`. The execctx census failed three times (`expected 60 to be 62`, the caught split `expected 10 to be 12`, and §7's control `expected 10 to be greater than or equal to 12`); the draft census twice (`expected [ …(7) ] to deeply equal [ …(8) ]`, `to have a length of 8 but got 7`).
  - The dogfood pair read `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)`: population `expected 68 to be 70`, and `/meta subset ↔ .call(` `expected 3 to be 2`.
  - `check:route-envelope` exited 1: `meta-item-write-routes.ts` NOT DECLARED. `check-system-context-census` exited 1 (above).
  - `check-adr-anchors` stayed green at 1775 (base 1783); `check:liveness`, `check:platform-checklist`, the runtime parity test and `repo` (`Tests 266 passed | 15 skipped (281)`) stayed green. Nine standing behaviour pins of the moved doors read `Tests 205 passed (205)`.
- **At `9ce268e26`** (the list grown, the readers not yet re-pointed): seven list readers read `Test Files 6 failed | 1 passed (7)`, `Tests 7 failed | 127 passed (134)` (the length pins and the unfloored module); `repo` read `Tests 2 failed | 268 passed | 16 skipped (286)`; the dogfood pair read `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)` (`registrar list length` and the tripwire length).
- **Green after the re-points** (`cbd7d7a4c`, then the merge head).

## Changeset

`.changeset/23050-s13c-meta-item-write-routes-move.md` is a `@objectstack/rest` patch (`Clause-②: no`, move-only). The shipped `index.js` / `index.cjs` bytes change (the marker above); the declarations and exports do not. `skip-changeset` does not apply.

## Acceptance notes

- The plan's 13c list held: the host's 5 members, the one receiver, the four leaving imports, the 16 / 3 list lengths, the census's two control changes, `MODULES` at 0 / 0 and the row-50 anchor. Beyond it, the ADR anchor (the handover's conditional item) was owed: the letter count dropped by 8. No reader outside the plan's list and 13b's handover read anything G5 held.
- The moved comments keep their deixis: "the `PUT` twins", "next door" and "a few hundred lines up" describe the inner method's order as it was, in which `POST {metaPath}/_migrate-stored` (now in `meta-collection-routes.ts`) sat above these doors. The module header says so rather than editing moved text.
- The inner method's `registerPerItemRoute` docblock still says the first four members of the per-item face "are inside the `if` block further down" (13b moved that block to `meta-item-read-routes.ts`). It is the inner head's text, a hold-off for this slice, and is left for the slice that re-reads that head.
- Carried from earlier slices, untouched: `FOLLOW-UPS.md:613` (E1) prose, `ui-routes.ts`' "52 sites" comment and `email-routes.ts`' double-mount header.

## Gates and tests

The final head is `892a86538`: one merge of `origin/main` `cbfa5e433` (#24244, `packages/runtime` only), then a comment-only fix to the new `MODULES` note in `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`. The tests below ran at the merge head `39912f9e1`; that last commit changes no file any test reads. The gate union ran at `892a86538`.

- **Build.** At base, `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/rest... --concurrency=2` exited 0 (`Tasks: 25 successful, 25 total`). At the move commit, `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/rest... --filter=@objectstack/dogfood... --filter=@objectstack/runtime... --concurrency=2` exited 0 (`Tasks: 66 successful, 66 total`). At the merge head, a whole-workspace `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2` exited 0 (`Tasks: 77 successful, 77 total`), for the dist readers.
